text: 01 · Worktrees Every agent in a project gets its own git worktree, so two agents working the same repo never touch the same files. Run a refactor and a bug fix at once and merge them on your own schedule. Projects billing-svc api-gateway offrun-site Agents Fix flaky upload test now Retry backoff 1m Refactor the parser 2m Token refresh 18m billing-svc fix-flaky-upload The upload test fails about one run in ten. Find out why and fix it. The test checked the file before the upload had finished, so it raced the network. It now waits for the upload itself instead of a fixed timer. Changed test/upload.test.js only, on this chat's own branch. It passed 50 runs in a row. Ask to make changes
